name: Philosophies of Fortitude
description:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Fortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.
It breeds the prosperity of life itself. The people here have never bowed to the biting cold, just as a fragile seed defiantly chooses to bloom amidst the blizzards. This civilization has witnessed centuries of bitter winter, yet remains vibrant much like the Frostfairy Flower that flourishes season after season.
